fact: Project Workflow describes the ordered project stages and their transitions.
A Stage is a unit of work in the Project Workflow with a defined result and condition for advancing.
The Main Session is the Pi conversation in which the user starts and monitors a Taskbook run.
A Subagent is a named task participant with its own session and assigned responsibility.
A new team run advances through Fact Check, intake Fact Management, Design, Implement, Review, final fact registration, and Handoff.
A Work State is a step in a single agent's playbook and determines which prompt it receives next.
A Work Turn is one invocation of a named Subagent in a specified Work State on versioned inputs.
A Round collects the results of a defined set of Work Turns before releasing their results to the next set.
Consult is a Work State in which the current agent classifies a question and resolves it or routes it to its owner.
A conflict with an authored fact pauses the project workflow for the user's decision.
